title: ParaTaxe: a Suite of Tools for Processing and Publishing Multi-parallel Corpora
abstract: arXiv:2610.32796v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Over the past fifteen years, digital tools for parallelizing and aligning textual corpora have developed significantly within the field of digital humanities. Several projects and software tools have been created to compare different translations or versions of texts. Despite these technical advances, many parallel corpora produced in academic contexts quickly become inaccessible online due to the lack of maintenance or funding. To address this gap, we present a suite of open-source tools developed within the ACR Grimm Tradalign and ParaTaxe projects. This suite includes the AIlign aligner, based on multilingual embeddings, a Python processing pipeline for converting and aligning corpora, a web interface called ParaTaxe for managing collections of parallel corpora, and a web interface for exploring aligned corpora built with TEI-Publisher.

translated_title: ParaTaxe：一套用于处理和发布多平行语料库的工具
translated_abstract: 在过去的十五年中，用于语料库平行化和对齐的数字工具在数字人文领域取得了显著发展。为了比较文本的不同译本或版本，学界已创建了多个项目和软件工具。然而，尽管有这些技术进步，许多在学术环境中产生的平行语料库由于缺乏维护或资金支持，很快就无法在线访问。为了解决这一缺口，我们展示了在 ACR Grimm Tradalign 和 ParaTaxe 项目中开发的一套开源工具。该套件包括基于多语言嵌入的 AIlign 对齐器、用于转换和对齐语料库的 Python 处理流程、一个名为 ParaTaxe 的用于管理平行语料库集合的网页界面，以及一个基于 TEI-Publisher 构建的用于浏览已对齐语料库的网页界面。
tldr: 该论文提出了一套开源工具套件（包括基于多语言嵌入的AIlign对齐器、Python处理流程以及用于管理和浏览平行语料库的网页界面），旨在解决学术平行语料库因缺乏维护和资金而难以在线持续访问的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a suite of open-source tools—including the AIlign aligner based on multilingual embeddings, a Python processing pipeline, and web interfaces for managing and exploring parallel corpora—to address the problem of academic parallel corpora quickly becoming inaccessible online due to lack of maintenance or funding.
